expectations.text: Replaces hosts, IP addresses, ports, timeout values and node identifiers with placeholders before grouping
expectations.evidence: Primary query keeps port and timeout literal: "connection to corvid://<node>:7946 refused after 20s" — only the node/IP got placeholders; port 7946 and "20s" remain literal.

expectations.text: Trims the client-library wrapper text (CorvidConnectionException, java.net.ConnectException) down to the innermost cause
expectations.evidence: The variant keeps the full wrapper chain: "CorvidConnectionException: caused by java.net.ConnectException: Connection refused" rather than trimming to just "Connection refused".

expectations.text: Produces one cluster per cause rather than one target per phrasing
expectations.evidence: One row "Connection refused reaching a Corvid node (port 7946)" groups Go, Java, and other phrasings into a single cluster.

expectations.text: Keeps the most frequent raw phrasings as a variants column on the cluster instead of as separate rows
expectations.evidence: The table's "Variants" column lists multiple phrasings under the one cluster row.

expectations.text: Separates the connection-refused subjects from the token-expired subjects into two distinct clusters
expectations.evidence: Connection-refused is ranked P1 in Ranked clusters; token-expired is a separate cluster placed in "Do not target".

expectations.text: Emits no keyword containing a hostname, IP address or port number
expectations.evidence: Primary query "connection to corvid://<node>:7946 refused after 20s" contains the literal port number 7946.

expectations.text: Counts evidence per cluster and per time window, not as a single undated total
expectations.evidence: "31 tickets / 2wk, evenly split across both weeks... (User-provided); 812 error-telemetry events / same window (User-provided)"

expectations.text: Flags the token-expired cluster as a regression tied to the 4.2 release and routes it to engineering rather than treating it as a docs gap
expectations.evidence: "Refused as a docs target: a cluster that appears only after a release is a regression signal to route to engineering... Recommend flagging to engineering as a P0 investigation"

expectations.text: Labels the ticket and telemetry counts Measured, with source, count and date
expectations.evidence: Counts are explicitly labeled "User-provided" throughout (e.g. "(User-provided — counts came from the requester's message, not from a pull I ran myself)"), never "Measured".

expectations.text: Routes the surviving docs-gap cluster to exactly one canonical error entry
expectations.evidence: "Target surface: Error entry" and "Ship one page with Go/Java tabs rather than two pages"

expectations.text: States that frequency alone does not decide the ranking, weighing time-to-resolve and whether a reader can self-serve the fix
expectations.evidence: No statement weighing time-to-resolve or self-serviceability against frequency; reasoning given is cost-to-write and steady-state nature only.
